semiconductor_relevance: High — ASFLOW provides critical components and materials for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and special gas lines.
summary: ASFLOW CO., LTD. specializes in producing high-purity pipeline components and materials for semiconductor equipment and special gas lines. Their offerings include filters, getters, purifiers, catalysts for gases, and various flow control components, all essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
capabilities: High-purity pipeline components for semiconductor equipment
Filters, getters, and purifiers for gases
Flow control components including valves, meters, and regulators
Gaskets, seals, and plumbing fittings tailored for semiconductor use

regional_presence.Korea: ASFLOW is a leading company in Korea, contributing significantly to the advancement of the components and materials industry for semiconductors.
